attempts.text:
**The window opens on the anchor.** Column 0, `mlaA`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.4% of calls. The model names 99% of them, at 0.07 bits.

**Then columns 7 to 13**, `yfcV` to `yfcO`, are [[fimbrial proteins]], carried by 30 to 81%, in a region of plasticity in 68 to 96% of calls. A second branch of 4 families runs through columns 8 to 11, [[fimbrial proteins]], in 10 to 14%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 96 against 88%, and hesitates less there, 0.17 against 0.29 bits. It hesitates most at column 8, `yfcU`, a fork column, 1.20 bits.

**The window ends in the `men` genes**, columns 75 to 79, [[succinyl hydroxy synthase]], carried by 41 to 73%. The last column is `menC`, in 41% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 91% of genes**, 0.25 bits on average, perplexity 1.5 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.91 against 0.14 bits, and names fewer genes, 62% against 96%.

label: mlaA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the mlaA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor mlaA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,368 to 1,447 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying mlaA once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.25 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,377 calls, named 97%, 0.10 bits; shell 7,390 calls, named 65%, 0.81 bits; cloud 433 calls, named 13%, 2.77 bits. Outside an RGP 36,782 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 6,418 calls, named 62%, 0.91 bits. Columns: 27 spine, 15 fork, 38 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.91 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (62% against 96%); 6,418 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 8 (yfcU, a fork column) 1.20 bits, RGP 95%; column 1 (yfdF, a fork column) 1.19 bits, RGP 0.4%; column 70 (yfbM, a fork column) 0.92 bits, RGP 25%. The 7 columns (columns 7-13) where most calls are in an RGP: named 58%, 0.51 bits on average; the other 73 columns: named 94%, 0.23 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 27 spine columns: named 96%, 0.17 bits on average; the 53 fork and variable columns: named 88%, 0.29 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 8, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 7-13 (fork), RGP 68-96%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0.4%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0.4%. Genes: mlaA. named 99%; 0.07 bits.
[S2] 2. column 1 fork: share 42%, all S, RGP 0.4%. named 60%; 1.19 bits.
[S2.c1]    1: yfdF S 42% "protein YfdF"; also yfdF (another family) S 29%
[S3] 3. columns 2-6 (5 columns) spine: share 94%, all P, RGP 4-23%. Genes: fadL, yfcZ "YfcZ/YiiS family protein", fadI, fadJ "fatty acid oxidation complex subuni…", sixA. named 85-97% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 6 (sixA), named 85%; most hesitant at column 2 (fadL), 0.34 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 7-13 (7 columns) fork: share 30-81%, all S, RGP 68-96%. named 21-75% (mean 58%), fewest named at column 10, named 21%; most hesitant at column 8, 1.20 bits.
[S4.b8]    a second branch of 4 families through columns 8-11, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-14%, all S; the branch's families: "fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone", "fimbrial protein", "fimbrial protein", "fimbrial protein"
[S4.c7]    7: yfcV S 64% "fimbrial protein"; also "fimbrial protein" S 12%
[S4.c8]    8: yfcU S 81% "fimbrial usher protein YfcU"
[S4.c9]    9: yfcS S 79% "fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone"
[S4.c10]    10: yfcR S 32% "fimbrial protein"; also "fimbrial protein" S 16%

[S4.c12]    12: yfcP S 50% "fimbrial protein"; also "fimbrial protein" S 12%
[S4.c13]    13: yfcO S 30% "fimbrial adhesin YfcO"; also "StfH/YfcO family fimbrial adhesin" S 14%
[S5] 5. columns 14-34 (21 columns) spine: share 90-94%, all P, RGP 1-15%. Genes: smrB, prmB, aroC, mepA, yfcA "sulfite exporter TauE/SafE family p…", epmC, yfcL "YfcL family protein", mnmC, fabB, yfcJ "MFS transporter", flk, pdxB, usg, truA, dedA, accD, folC, dedD, cvpA, purF, ubiX. named 85-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 34 (ubiX), named 85%; most hesitant at column 14 (smrB), 0.29 bits.
[S6] 6. columns 35-79 (45 columns) fork and variable columns: share 26-90%, 43 P, 2 S, RGP 1-29%. named 66-99% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 36, named 66%; most hesitant at column 70, 0.92 bits.
